title: glab api projects/${project}
description: A project, read by its id, a merge request's branch's when it is not this project, whose namespace's full path kit reads as the fork's owner in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:open-prs); or this project, read by its path, whose shared_with_groups kit draws as the teams stage's, the first 20 of them (forge/gitlab:teams, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::gitlab_teams). The types are APIEntitiesProjectsWithAccessAndCatalogSetting, APIEntitiesNamespaceBasic, and the shared groups of GET /api/v4/projects/{id} in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, as https://docs.gitlab.com/api/projects/ describes it.

full_path.description: The path of the group, with its parent groups, or of the user that owns the project.

group_access_level.description: The access the share gives: 10 guest, 20 reporter, 30 developer, 40 maintainer, 50 owner.
